className.en-US: Class name of the root `ul` element.

style.zh-CN: 根元素 `ul` 的内联样式。
style.en-US: Inline style of the root `ul` element.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素 `ul` 的 ref，两种尺寸一致。
ref.en-US: Ref of the root `ul` element, in both sizes.

total.zh-CN: 总条数。总条数变化时，非受控的分页器回到第 1 页；受控时页码以 `currentPage` 为准。
total.en-US: Total number of items. When it changes, an uncontrolled pagination goes back to page 1; when controlled, the page follows `currentPage`.

showTotal.zh-CN: 是否显示总页数，`size` 为 `small` 时不显示。
showTotal.en-US: Whether to show the total number of pages; not shown when `size` is `small`.

pageSize.zh-CN: 每页条数，未传时取 `pageSizeOpts` 的第一项。非严格受控：每页条数选择器的选择保留在组件内部，只有该属性变为与当前不同的值时才会覆盖它，并回到第 1 页（受控时回到 `currentPage`）；在 `onChange` 中回写该属性不会重置页码。
pageSize.en-US: Number of items per page; falls back to the first item of `pageSizeOpts`. Not strictly controlled: the choice made in the size changer is kept inside, and only a change of this prop to a value other than the current one overrides it and goes back to page 1 (to `currentPage` when controlled). Writing it back from `onChange` does not reset the page.

pageSizeOpts.zh-CN: 每页条数选择器的可选值；当前每页条数不在其中时按大小插入选项。
pageSizeOpts.en-US: Options of the size changer; the current page size is inserted in order when it is not among them.

currentPage.zh-CN: 当前页码。传入后分页器受控，页码完全由该属性决定；不传（undefined）时由组件自己管理。
currentPage.en-US: Current page. Once set the pagination is controlled and the page is entirely determined by this prop; when undefined the component manages the page itself.

showSizeChanger.zh-CN: 是否显示每页条数选择器，`size` 为 `small` 时不生效。开启后 `hideOnSinglePage` 不再生效。
showSizeChanger.en-US: Whether to show the size changer; has no effect when `size` is `small`. When it is shown, `hideOnSinglePage` no longer takes effect.

showQuickJumper.zh-CN: 是否显示快速跳转输入框，总页数小于 2 时禁用。
showQuickJumper.en-US: Whether to show the quick jump input; disabled when there are fewer than 2 pages.

popoverPosition.zh-CN: 省略页码浮层与每页条数下拉的位置。未传时每页条数下拉为 `bottomLeft`（RTL 下 `bottomRight`），省略页码浮层使用 Popover 的默认位置 `bottom`；`size` 为 `small` 时不使用。
popoverPosition.en-US: Position of the omitted pages popover and the size changer dropdown. When omitted the size changer dropdown uses `bottomLeft` (`bottomRight` in RTL) and the omitted pages popover uses the Popover default `bottom`; not used when `size` is `small`.

hideOnSinglePage.zh-CN: 总页数小于 2 时是否隐藏分页器；每页条数选择器显示时不生效。
hideOnSinglePage.en-US: Whether to hide the pagination when there are fewer than 2 pages; has no effect while the size changer is shown.

hoverShowPageSelect.zh-CN: 仅 `size` 为 `small` 时生效：悬停或聚焦页码文字时打开页码列表。
hoverShowPageSelect.en-US: Only when `size` is `small`: the page list opens when the page text is hovered or focused.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用。禁用时翻页按钮、页码、每页条数选择器与快速跳转均不可用。
disabled.en-US: Whether disabled. When disabled, the navigation buttons, the page numbers, the size changer and the quick jumper are all unavailable.

preventPageChangeOnPageSizeChange.zh-CN: 切换每页条数时保持当前页码不变且不触发 `onPageChange`，新的页码由使用方在 `onPageSizeChange` 中决定。
preventPageChangeOnPageSizeChange.en-US: Keeps the current page when the page size changes without calling `onPageChange`; the consumer picks the new page in `onPageSizeChange`.

prevText.zh-CN: 替换上一页按钮的内容。纯文本时按钮以该文字命名，其他内容（图标、元素）仍使用语言包的名称；为空时保留默认图标与语言包名称。
prevText.en-US: Replaces the content of the previous page button. A plain text names the button, and any other content (an icon, an element) keeps the locale name; empty content keeps the default icon and the locale name.

nextText.zh-CN: 替换下一页按钮的内容，命名规则同 `prevText`。
nextText.en-US: Replaces the content of the next page button, named the same way as `prevText`.

onPageChange.zh-CN: 页码变化时的回调，参数为新的页码。
onPageChange.en-US: Called when the page changes, with the new page.

onPageSizeChange.zh-CN: 每页条数变化时的回调，参数为新的每页条数。
onPageSizeChange.en-US: Called when the page size changes, with the new page size.

onChange.zh-CN: 页码或每页条数变化时的回调，参数为页码与每页条数。
onChange.en-US: Called when the page or the page size changes, with the page and the page size.
